(ORDER LIST:  609 U.S.) 
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 16, 2026 
CERTIORARI DENIED 
26-5558 NORMAN, LeJAMES V. TEXAS 
(26A353) 
The application for stay of execution of sentence of death 
presented to Justice Alito and by him referred to the Court is 
denied.  The petition for a writ of certiorari is denied. 
The motion for leave to file a petition for a writ of 
certiorari under seal with redacted copies for public record is 
granted.
